curation.lead:
SPQR Capital Holding SA is a Luxembourg-domiciled investment holding company registered at the Luxembourg Trade and Companies Register under number B150334, founded by the French finance executive Bertrand Gauquelin des Pallières and chaired from 1 March 2016 by the Italian financier Alessandro Benedetti [Finding #11215][Finding #11221][REG:LU:B150334]. According to NorthData and Luxembourg RCS filings, the company maintained its registered office at 12 rue Guillaume Schneider, L-2522 Luxembourg, the NeoTrust Fiduciary domicile shared with Compagnie Du Saleve SA and at least eleven entities recorded in the ICIJ Panama Papers leak [Finding #11215][Finding #11129][REG:LU:B150334]. The vehicle entered liquidation on 16 March 2023 under court-appointed liquidator Christian Steinmetz [Finding #11215][Finding #11114].

SPQR was formed by a three-person breakaway from Deutsche Bank Principal Finance in 2007 — des Pallières, Malik Chaabouni, and Moez Ben-Zid — and operated as a junior bondholder in the Wind Hellas / TIM Hellas creditor litigation against Naguib Sawiris's Weather Investments, in which SPQR and other subordinated noteholders were reported to have suffered total losses on their position [Finding #11114][Finding #11149][Finding #11221]. According to the Luxembourg RCS director timeline, des Pallières, Benedetti, and the Luxembourg corporate-administration director Mathieu Villaume were appointed to the SPQR board on the same day, 1 March 2016, during the active phase of that creditor activity [Finding #11215][Finding #11226][REG:LU:B150334].

SPQR's Swiss arm, SPQR Capital Services Sagl, was registered in Lugano on 17 March 2011 under company number CHE-496.390.425 with chair Alessandro Benedetti [Finding #11215][Finding #11103]. SPQR Capital Holding SA functioned as the central Luxembourg vehicle around which the Benedetti–des Pallières corporate constellation revolved until liquidation; the same three-handed director composition recurs across Attali Investment Partners Ltd, Equus Total Return Inc, Cadogan Petroleum plc, and Bitfury Group Limited [Finding #11101][Finding #11103][Finding #11221].
curation.system_role: SPQR Capital Holding SA functioned as the Luxembourg fund-vehicle anchor of the Benedetti–des Pallières–Misra board constellation: a single registered office at 12 rue Guillaume Schneider hosted both SPQR and a Rothschild & Co Five Arrows portfolio company, and the same three directors signed for SPQR while pursuing the Wind Hellas creditor litigation that intersected the SoftBank-era reputational campaigns reported by the Wall Street Journal.

sections.title: Corporate Structure and Registration
sections.content:
SPQR Capital Holding SA was incorporated in Luxembourg under Luxembourg Trade and Companies Register number B150334 and maintained its registered office at 12 rue Guillaume Schneider, L-2522 Luxembourg, the domicile maintained by the corporate-services provider NeoTrust Fiduciary [Finding #11215][REG:LU:B150334]. According to Luxembourg RCS filings retrieved via NorthData, the same address simultaneously hosted Compagnie Du Saleve SA (Luxembourg RCS B223232), wholly owned since 8 March 2023 by Five Arrows AutoBench Holding Sàrl, the private-equity arm of Rothschild & Co [Finding #11211][Finding #11129][REG:LU:B223232]. Investigation finding #11129 also documents that the 12 rue Guillaume Schneider address corresponds to eleven entities indexed in the ICIJ Panama Papers leak, including Kaupthing Bank Luxembourg SA variants and bearer-share entries [Finding #11129].

The company was a closed Luxembourg société anonyme operating as the holding tier above SPQR's investment activity. According to SEC EDGAR DEF 14A filings for Equus Total Return Inc and the company's UK Companies House and SEC disclosures, Alessandro Benedetti served as a director of SPQR Capital Holdings SA from August 2010 onward [Finding #847][SEC:878932]. The Luxembourg arm operated alongside SPQR Capital Services Sagl, a Lugano entity registered on 17 March 2011 under company number CHE-496.390.425 with capital of CHF 20,000 and chair Alessandro Benedetti [Finding #11215][Finding #11103]. Investigation finding #11114 records the additional UK and Cayman entities in the SPQR group, including SPQR Capital (Cayman) Ltd, identifying SPQR Capital Holding SA as the Luxembourg apex of the structure [Finding #11114][Finding #11221].

sections.title: Directors and the 1 March 2016 Simultaneous Installation
sections.content:
According to the Luxembourg RCS director timeline retrieved via NorthData, three SPQR Capital Holding SA directors were appointed on the same day, 1 March 2016: Alessandro Benedetti as chair, Bertrand G. des Pallières, and Mathieu Villaume [Finding #11215][REG:LU:B150334]. Villaume departed on 7 February 2018, and Michel Thill served briefly between October 2021 and August 2022 [Finding #11215]. According to investigation finding #11226, the configuration is characterised as a simultaneous board installation pattern coincident with the active phase of the Wind Hellas / TIM Hellas creditor litigation against Naguib Sawiris's Weather Investments; according to the same finding, that pattern is presented as synthesis rather than confirmed fact and is attributed accordingly [Finding #11226]. According to investigation finding #11226, the three-handed director composition — a private-equity principal, a hedge-fund founder, and a Luxembourg corporate-administration director — corresponds to a typical Luxembourg fund-vehicle governance shape rather than a unique structural design [Finding #11226].

Each director's record is documented in independent registry sources. UK Companies House filings, ICIJ Paradise Papers data, and OCCRP Aleph entries for Benedetti record his concurrent roles as CEO of SAE Capital Ltd, executive chairman of Equus Total Return Inc (NYSE: EQS, June 2011 – June 2014), and designated member of Asherco LLP (UK OC379532) [Finding #11103][Finding #847][SEC:878932]. Des Pallières's career, recorded by UK Companies House and Luxembourg RCS filings, spans Managing Director and Global Head of Structured Credit at JPMorgan (1992–2005), Managing Director and Global Head of Principal Finance at Deutsche Bank (2005–2007), and CEO/founder of SPQR Capital Holdings SA from 2010 onward [Finding #11221][Finding #11101][Finding #11114]. Villaume's NorthData profile lists more than 21 active Luxembourg mandates including Compagnie Du Saleve SA and the Knightsbridge Capital Partners Holding I/II/III SA series [Finding #11223][Finding #11129].

According to investigation finding #11129, the Luxembourg full legal name of des Pallières that appears on registry filings is "Bertrand Ghislain Yves Gauquelin des Pallières," and prior referencing of him as "Stéphane des Pallières" was a misidentification that finding #11215 explicitly corrects [Finding #11129][Finding #11215][Finding #11221]. Finding #11129 also notes that Benedetti and "Bertrand Gauquelin" jointly resigned from SPQR on 18 December 2015, and that the 1 March 2016 reinstallation of all three directors followed shortly after [Finding #11129].

sections.title: Wind Hellas / TIM Hellas Creditor Activity
sections.content:
SPQR Capital was a noteholder in the Wind Hellas / TIM Hellas Greek telecommunications creditor dispute that culminated in Naguib Sawiris's Weather Investments acquiring the group out of administration. According to the trade publication privatefundscfo.com cited in investigation finding #11149, SPQR was among the bondholders that suffered effectively total losses on their subordinated position [Finding #11149]. The same finding records that SPQR was not a named plaintiff in Adversary Proceeding 14-01848 before Hon. Martin Glenn in the United States Bankruptcy Court for the Southern District of New York, but participated as a beneficial holder represented through Wilmington Trust and the Cortlandt Street Recovery litigation-funding vehicle [Finding #11149].

According to investigation finding #11221, Bertrand G. des Pallières publicly called on the Institute of Chartered Accountants in England and Wales to investigate Ernst & Young over the Wind Hellas administration after SPQR Capital and other junior bondholders were reported to have lost millions when Sawiris's Weather Investments wiped approximately GBP 1.3 billion of debt acquiring the group out of administration [Finding #11221]. Finding #11125 records that the Independent's article of 28 October 2015 by Jim Armitage and Mark Hollingsworth, titled "The private equity giants, the Greek target, and a Trojan horse," identifies "SPQR Capital's Bertrand des Pallieres" as the on-the-record creditor source for that piece [Finding #11125].

Finding #11149 documents the procedural history of the related litigation in detail, including the Hon. Martin Glenn opinions Hosking I through Hosking IV (2015–2016), the forum non conveniens stay granted on 19 August 2016, the termination of the adversary proceeding on 4 August 2022, and the closure of the Chapter 15 case on 21 November 2022 [Finding #11149]. The same finding records that the Luxembourg Tribunal d'Arrondissement on 23 December 2015 held that the Convertible Preferred Equity Certificates at issue were debt instruments not subject to Luxembourg companies-law illegal-dividend rules — a decision finding #11149 describes as foreclosing the parallel "fraudulent dividend" theory advanced in the United States and United Kingdom [Finding #11149].

sections.title: Sister Entity: SPQR Capital Services Sagl
sections.content:
SPQR Capital Services Sagl is the Swiss arm of the SPQR group, registered with the Lugano commercial register on 17 March 2011 under company number CHE-496.390.425 with subscribed capital of CHF 20,000 and chair Alessandro Benedetti [Finding #11215][Finding #11103]. The Lugano entity sits inside Benedetti's broader Swiss-Italian financial constellation alongside Schwarzfield SA (Luxembourg/Geneva), Schwarzfield Services SAGL (Lugano), and a recorded set of approximately 22 entities across Italy, the United Kingdom, Luxembourg, Switzerland, the British Virgin Islands, Malta, the United States, France, the Netherlands, and Panama [Finding #11103].

According to investigation finding #11103, Benedetti's UK Companies House and SEC EDGAR records situate SPQR Capital Services Sagl alongside SAE Capital Ltd (UK), Asherco LLP (UK OC379532), Tree of Life Limited (Malta C67345, ICIJ Paradise Papers), and Barkmere Group Ltd (BVI) — the BVI entity that the Wall Street Journal of 27 February 2020 reported received USD 500,000 from Rajeev Misra [Finding #11103]. Finding #11103 is presented as paraphrase synthesis of registry and ICIJ data and is attributed accordingly.

sections.title: Liquidation and Wind-Down
sections.content:
According to the Luxembourg RCS record retrieved via NorthData, SPQR Capital Holding SA entered liquidation on 16 March 2023 under court-appointed liquidator Christian Steinmetz [Finding #11215][REG:LU:B150334]. Mathieu Villaume had departed the board approximately five years earlier, on 7 February 2018, and the brief October 2021 – August 2022 directorship of Michel Thill ended several months before the liquidation filing [Finding #11215][Finding #11223].

Investigation finding #11114 confirms that as of the OneIM team-page disclosure, Bertrand G. des Pallières had moved into a Partner – Private Credit role at OneIM, the Abu Dhabi vehicle of Rajeev Misra [Finding #11114]. The investigation finding describes this transition as a re-platforming of the Centricus and SPQR-era circle into the OneIM vehicle within the broader Mubadala/Royal Group ecosystem associated with Sheikh Tahnoon bin Zayed Al Nahyan; that interpretation is presented as paraphrase synthesis [Finding #11114].

sections.title: Significance to the Investigation
sections.content:
SPQR Capital Holding SA is the Luxembourg vehicle that anchors the recurring Benedetti–des Pallières–Villaume director set across the corporate constellation reconstructed in investigation findings #11103 and #11221 [Finding #11103][Finding #11221]. The same three-handed board configuration appears in Attali Investment Partners Ltd (UK 07138407), Equus Total Return Inc (NYSE: EQS), Cadogan Petroleum plc, Bitfury Group Limited (UK 11441275), and the Methorios Capital LLP corporate-director chain — a pattern that finding #11101 describes as the structural bridge between the SoftBank Vision Fund principal Rajeev Misra and the Italian financier Alessandro Benedetti [Finding #11101][Finding #11221].

According to investigation finding #11166, Mathieu Villaume's simultaneous mandates at SPQR Capital Holding SA, Compagnie Du Saleve SA (the Five Arrows AutoBench Holding portfolio entity), and the Knightsbridge Capital Partners Holding I/II/III SA series link the Benedetti–des Pallières cluster to the Rothschild & Co private-equity arm on the same Luxembourg address [Finding #11166]. According to the same finding, this connection is presented as synthesis of registry data and ICIJ Paradise Papers node 56009779 [Finding #11166]. The Wall Street Journal coverage of 27 February 2020 cited in finding #11101 is the only one of the public reporting streams catalogued in this investigation that publicly names des Pallières as the introducer between Misra and Benedetti [Finding #11101]. SPQR Capital Holding SA is therefore the corporate hinge — the registered vehicle that documents the sequence of director appointments through which the Wind Hellas creditor litigation, the Bitfury Group governance ties recorded in finding #11114, and the Five Arrows / Rothschild address overlap recorded in finding #11211 are joined [Finding #11149][Finding #11211][Finding #11114].

open_questions: Which counterparties received SPQR Capital Holding SA's Wind Hellas creditor distribution recoveries through the Cortlandt Street Recovery / Wilmington Trust funding chain, and were any of those flows recorded in Luxembourg or US bankruptcy filings beyond the materials catalogued in finding #11149?

What was the originating share-capital subscription and ultimate beneficial-owner structure of SPQR Capital Holding SA at the 2010 incorporation, and is there a Luxembourg RCS or ICIJ Open Corporates record for the original three-person founding team (des Pallières, Malik Chaabouni, Moez Ben-Zid)?

Did the 16 March 2023 liquidator Christian Steinmetz file a final liquidation report with the Luxembourg RCS that itemises remaining SPQR assets and any transfer of holdings to OneIM or successor vehicles in the Misra–Tahnoon ecosystem?

Which of the eleven Panama Papers entities recorded by finding #11129 at 12 rue Guillaume Schneider share officers, beneficial owners, or counterparties with SPQR Capital Holding SA beyond the documented overlap with Compagnie Du Saleve SA?

What is the relationship, if any, between SPQR Capital Holding SA and the Bitfury Group Limited (UK 11441275) governance recorded in finding #11114 — that is, does Bitfury appear in any SPQR portfolio filing, or is the link through des Pallières's personal directorship only?
